title: AttestationView
description: Source of truth: Holochain DHT (elohim DNA, Content entry, content_type LIKE 'attestation:%', Category A per p2p-design-gate). This record is a read-optimised projection populated by the AttestationProjector post-commit signal. If this projection and the DHT disagree, the DHT wins.

dhtAnchorHash.description: ActionHash (hex) of the DHT entry — provenance anchor

subjectCid.description: CID of the entity being attested

subjectKind.description: Kind of the subject: agent | content | device | hub | computation | governance-action

parentGovernanceActionCid.description: CID of the parent governance-action, if this attestation is a vote

voteWeight.description: Optional vote weight as a decimal string (null when unweighted)

proofClass.description: Proof class: witness | self-attest | audit-signature | computational

supersedesCid.description: CID of the attestation this one supersedes, if any

revocationReason.description: Reason this attestation was revoked, if revoked

title.description: Human-readable title from the Content entry

description.description: Optional description from the Content entry
